name: criterion-7
text: Criterion 7 (O-1A 7, EB-1A viii): critical or essential role for an organization with a distinguished reputation.
Counts (C7-critical-role): founder of an incorporated company with governance documents; a well-funded startup counts as a distinguished organization, strengthened by funding, accelerator or press.
Rejected (T-title-only): a title without evidence about the organization.
